node.title: Transmisión de juicio tácito
node.summary: People learn to recognise exceptions through situated practice.

relations: An operator-led walkthrough could make the judgment behind the exhibit teachable without pretending the interface contains all tacit knowledge.
Un screencast no captura todo el juicio tácito ni convierte una reconstrucción en evidencia de una operación nueva.
Knowledge-transfer evidence can include safe novel-exception exercises rather than relying only on document completion.
Los ejercicios deben ser seguros y simulados: no apagar una planta real ni retirar controles. El protocolo HID no demuestra resultados del caso histórico.
The China account describes communities proposed and initiated for regional transfer; tacit-knowledge transmission provides a complementary explanation of what such transfer requires.
La fuente no demuestra adopción ni resultados de todas las comunidades; el paper de Tiger Teams no acredita participación en aquellas sesiones.
The calibration case distinguishes knowledge that can be taught through practice from information that an application inventory cannot reconstruct by itself.
No todo saber tácito es irrecuperable; distinguir falta de captura, coste de recuperación y pérdida efectiva.
The minimum information for an architecture decision may include an operator's situated judgment, making its acquisition a real project cost.
El mínimo depende de la decisión, y la observación puede alterar la práctica que intenta describir.
Cross-border knowledge transfer includes the ability to handle local exceptions, not merely the movement of manuals or personnel.
El relato no constituye una medición del efecto económico de la migración ni de una transferencia completa.
Where a record cannot reconstruct situated judgment, capability preservation may require a live transmission relationship rather than another layer of documentation.
No afirmar que todo conocimiento tácito sea irrecuperable ni que mentoría garantice reconstrucción completa.
Tacit-knowledge concentration can inform a contribution estimate when tied to observable exception handling and replacement conditions rather than reputation.
Dependencia de una persona no es automáticamente capacidad que conviene perpetuar; puede revelar fragilidad y necesidad de transmisión.
A practice-based transmission programme could provide the capability-recovery arm of an HID intervention, separately from the integration fix that releases time.
Aprender otra tarea no eleva automáticamente ρ; contabilizar coste, capacidad objetivo y posible recuperación completa o nula.
The Texas-to-Mexico case makes regional capability formation tangible through local roles, acceptance criteria and operating records that let the receiving team execute in its own context.
La preparación audit-ready descrita no equivale a certificación universal ni demuestra por sí sola autonomía futura de cada equipo.
Tacit-knowledge transmission offers a practical route for making activation capacity less dependent on a few irreplaceable carriers at the critical moment.
La transmisión no garantiza una densidad κ ni una respuesta superior bajo cualquier carga o régimen.
Preserving an artifact is only one layer; the tacit-knowledge model explains how observation, rehearsal and apprenticeship can preserve the judgment needed to use it.
La comparación propone una forma de transmisión; no prueba que todo conocimiento preservado se haya transmitido con éxito.
The watchmaking case suggests a practical distinction between commemorating inherited know-how and keeping it usable within a federated operating architecture.
Analogía entre contextos; preservar maestría no exige conservar cada proceso, sistema o coste histórico.
The community-of-practice idea becomes operational when participants can observe judgment, rehearse it and retain an apprenticeship path for novel exceptions.
La afinidad metodológica no demuestra que toda comunidad o encuentro produzca una capacidad duradera.
The ceramics interview provides a bounded illustration of practice exchange; it does not by itself establish a sustained community or lasting skill transfer.
La entrevista registra una experiencia y propósitos; no contiene una evaluación longitudinal de aprendizaje.
The ceramics encounter can illustrate situated transmission, while the tacit-knowledge model supplies questions for observing practice and later independent judgment.
La entrevista acredita el relato del encuentro; el seguimiento de aprendizaje es una propuesta, no un dato ya recogido.
Craft exchange and federated watchmaking suggest a shared design question: what must travel between specialists so that coordination preserves rather than flattens their skills?
No se equiparan sectores, calidad de producto ni resultados. Es una comparación de transmisión e interfaz, no de rendimiento.
Tacit-knowledge transmission could inform a recovery study that distinguishes freed hours from renewed capability to handle novel exceptions.
No se asigna un valor ρ ni se presenta aprendizaje relatado por un Tiger Team como prueba de irreversibilidad.
